oc_views.occurrences_enriched.view_definition:
SELECT o.occurrence_id,
    o.scientific_name AS original_name,
    r.resolved_taxon_id,
    t.scientific_name AS resolved_name,
    t.genus,
    t.species,
    o.latitude,
    o.longitude
   FROM oc_atlas.occurrences o
     LEFT JOIN oc_resolver.occurrence_taxon_resolved r ON o.occurrence_id = r.occurrence_id
     LEFT JOIN orchid_taxonomy t ON r.resolved_taxon_id = t.id;

public.v_orchid_records.view_definition:
SELECT record_id,
    source,
    source_record_id,
    record_type,
    scientific_name_raw,
    taxon_id_matched,
    genus,
    species,
    infraspecific,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    country,
    state_province,
    locality,
    event_date,
    observer_or_collector,
    dataset_or_source_title,
    citation,
    record_json,
    created_at,
    updated_at,
    gbif_occurrence_key,
    elevation_m,
    elevation_min_m,
    elevation_max_m,
    elevation_as_stated,
    geom,
    elevation_source,
    elevation_method,
    elevation_model,
    elevation_resolution_m,
    elevation_confidence,
    elevation_updated_at,
    elevation_dem_m,
    elevation_dem_source,
    elevation_dem_method,
    elevation_dem_model,
    elevation_dem_confidence,
    elevation_dem_lat,
    elevation_dem_lon,
    elevation_dem_updated_at,
    elevation_effective_m,
    accepted_taxon_id,
    scientific_name_clean,
    eol_page_id,
    name_source,
    scientific_binomial,
    is_orchid
   FROM records
  WHERE is_orchid = true;
